title: Relativistic energy-momentum relation
references: Rindler, W., Relativity: Special, General, and Cosmological, 2nd ed., Oxford University Press (2006)
Taylor, E. F. and Wheeler, J. A., Spacetime Physics, 2nd ed., W. H. Freeman (1992)
validity_domain: Total energy of a free body or particle of rest mass m and momentum magnitude p in an inertial frame, in special relativity.
limitations: Total energy including rest energy, not kinetic energy
Free body: no potential energy, no field energy
The 0.5 % tolerance covers the rounding of a stated figure, it is not a physical uncertainty
